digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的模块化能力，让 Agent 快速掌握专业任务执行方法

repos.name: lobehub/lobehub
repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.

repos.name: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills

repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 和网页自动调研任意话题并生成有据可依的总结

repos.summary_zh: 跨平台GPU任务管理器，实时监控每进程显存与GPU活动，还提供大模型KV缓存洞察，通吃NVIDIA、AMD、Intel及昇腾

repos.name: a2ui-project/a2ui
repos.description: Open-source generative UI framework: agents stream layout data, and apps render it with native components in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 流式输出布局数据，由 React、Flutter、SwiftUI 等原生组件直接渲染的生成式 UI 框架

papers.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming

papers.summary_zh: 提出面向混合架构大模型的透明缓存管理与逐层流式服务系统，统一调度异构缓存并降低显存占用提升吞吐

papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher

papers.title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning

papers.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience

papers.summary_zh: 提出基于视觉智能体试玩体验自动设计游戏框架PlayCraft，以掌握感为核心优化可玩性与吸引力

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, exi
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向前沿智能体直接机器人控制的细粒度评测框架AgentRoboCritic，突破仅看回合成功率的局限，揭示其底层动作生成能力与失败模式

papers.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulner

papers.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
